sourceFile: 51. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test compare dry 12h semi sub 3 and dry 12h final sample  -  date 2026.01.06_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Primary comparison is ambiguous between dry vs not dry and final sample vs semi sub 3.
Baseline and test conditions are mixed into one changedCondition.
Not dry 12h is treated as subgroup but appears to be a comparison condition.
Measurement outcome is likely a misclassified defect-category header/stat extraction.
Decision row supports NG reduction after final dry, but judgement is not incorporated.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the primary comparison dry 12h final sample vs not dry 12h, or dry 12h final sample vs dry 12h semi sub 3?
correctionPlan: Define one primary changed factor from title, content, result rows, and decision.
Set Not dry 12h as baseline only if used as the control condition.
Keep Final sample dry 12h and Semi sub 3 dry 12h as separate compared conditions, not one combined test condition.
Remove the measurement outcome unless source rows prove real measurement statistics.
Use result rows 17, 19, 21 plus decision row 25 as evidence for function NG comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited grouping is insufficient until condition roles are corrected.
